# ctx-max — review fix (quokka P2 on 819b43229)

**Commit on main:** `69031952b` fix(terminal): rank window seats by unclamped context fill (fast-forward on `a31aa7976`).

**Finding:** `fullestContext` ranked by `contextFill`, which is clamped to 0–1 for the bar. A seat reporting more than its window (1.2M of 1M) tied with one exactly full and lost to the earlier seat: the window named the wrong seat and token counts.

**Fix:** rank by `usedTokens / windowTokens` unclamped; the clamp stays for the bar and percentage; equal ratios keep the earlier seat. Regression test in `context-fill.test.tsx` (1.0 vs 1.2 picks the 1.2 seat with `seats: 2`; 500/1000 vs 1000/2000 keeps the first). It fails on the old ranking and passes on the fix.

**just fft** (nice -n 19, worktree `chainglass-ctx-rank`, 17:17–17:26, load 31.8 → 68.3): lint clean (1812 files); build 7/7; typecheck 9/9 configs; vitest 556 files / 7332 tests passed (7 files / 60 skipped, existing); `pnpm audit --audit-level=high` 0 high (3 low, 16 moderate). Same three Turbopack warnings in untouched files as earlier runs; stderr from passing tests unchanged (105 blocks). Log `/tmp/ctx-rank-fft.log`.

**Kept:** worktree `chainglass-ctx-rank`, branch `ctx-rank`, `.next` BUILD_ID `lNkNlpw_3qhAF2n-Wt3TS`; also `chainglass-ctx-max` (its `.next` was rebuilt at 16:11 from an earlier copy of this fix, `2b451bccd`, after the reviewer released it).
